name: ProjectPermit
tagline: Evidence-linked municipal permit preflight for construction and renovation agents
description: A hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server that turns normalized construction or renovation scope into deterministic, evidence-linked municipal permit/planning preflight results. Current coverage includes Gatineau, Ottawa, Toronto, Mississauga, Laval, Longueuil, and Vancouver. The developer-validation endpoint is currently open and requires no API key. Results preserve uncertainty and are not municipal authorization or legal/engineering advice.

install.notes: No authentication is required during the current developer-validation preview. Call projectpermit_info first to discover supported jurisdiction IDs and project families before calling check_project_requirements.
